description.narrative: Based in India, Dhaatri Trust works at the intersections of environmental justice and gender equality from an eco-feminist framework. Combining field actions with policy lobbying to support the rights of women, its primary focus is on building the leadership and networking of indigenous and rural women to articulate their concerns vis-à-vis land, forests and natural resources. Strategies include facilitating a national platform for grassroots women to learn and exchange on laws, policies, field action strategies, innovative practices, and intergenerational knowledge sharing of cultural and ecological knowledge particularly among indigenous elders and youth. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Core organizational expenses; - Development and implementation of a feminist ecology training course for youth.
